name: Absorb
addedEffect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

name: Accelerock
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon dashes at great speed using the rocks on their body to strike the foe upon impact.

name: Acid
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
flavorText: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

name: Acid Armor
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
flavorText: Highly acidic goop oozes through the pores of this Pokémon. Touching it immediately causes a burning pain. Preventing foes from getting too close.

name: Acid Downpour
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Acid Spray
addedEffect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
flavorText: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

name: Acrobatics
addedEffect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon is quick and graceful, they cartwheel, contort and make a double back jump before landing onthe foe. Their best perfomance is done when they are unburdened.

name: Acupressure
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 one of the User's Attributes or Traits at Random (Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, Sp. Defense, Accuracy, Evasion). If this Move is used again, the previous Attribute increase is removed.
flavorText: The user begins pushing pressure points on their body to unlock a hidden potential they didn’t even knew they had.

name: Aerial Ace
addedEffect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
flavorText: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

name: Aeroblast
addedEffect: Single Target. Wind Move. Lethal. High Critical. Unique.
flavorText: The victim is trapped in a violently swirling vortex. The strong wind currents make debris fly everywhere.

name: After You
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The user bows and courteously lets a friend go first.

name: Agility
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
flavorText: Swift of body, swift of mind.

name: Air Cutter
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. High Critical. Wind Move. Cutter Move.
flavorText: A sharp wide wave of wind is sent out , everyone can feel it slicing throught their midsection.

name: Air Slash
addedEffect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

name: All-Out Pummeling
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Remove Barriers, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Alluring Voice
addedEffect: Single Target. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
flavorText: Since ancient times, sailors have warned against the siren’s alluring voice calling out for you in the middle of the sea. Now you know why.

name: Ally Switch
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 3. Switcher Move for the User. If successful, restore the Action this Move costed and the switched ally may use a Reaction when they enter the field.
flavorText: The user vanishes just as they were about to be hit, and suddenly there’s another Pokémon in their place. Di-Did the user disappear? Or was it never there to begin with?

name: Ambush
addedEffect: Single Target. Before the Battle starts, Target may resist by rolling: Insight + Alert and scoring the same or more Successes. The User has 1 Action before Initiatives are rolled in which the Target can't act. Other foes can still Evade or Clash during this time.
flavorText: Sneak through the shadows, stay low to the ground, and prepare yourself to pounce on an unsuspecting foe.

name: Amnesia
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
flavorText: No thoughts. Head empty

name: Anchor Shot
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon hurls an anchor at the foe and entangles it with seaweed, the anchor drags the foe down so it cannot escape.

name: Ancient Power
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

name: Apple Acid
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Foe's Sp. Defense by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon produces a sap from the tart apples they feed on, if the apples are not ripe their sap will be acidic and bad for teeth.

name: Aqua Cutter
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
flavorText: The User compacts water and shoots it as a pressurized jet. This jet is very sharp and can easily cut through solids.

name: Aqua Jet
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

name: Aqua Ring
addedEffect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

name: Aqua Step
addedEffect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: The most fluid dance steps you’ll ever see. The user toys with their target by kicking and splashing around.

name: Aqua Tail
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

name: Arm Thrust
addedEffect: Single Target. Successive Actions.
flavorText: A quick and relentless series of open-palmed thrusts against the foe.

name: Armor Cannon
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The user shoots a mighty blast by using its own armor out as blazing projectiles.

name: Aromatherapy
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Cure Status Ailments (All Burn degrees, Freeze, Paralysis, All Poison & Sleep) on the Targets.
flavorText: The Pokémon releases a series of essential oils and herbal scents to refresh themselves and their companions.

name: Aromatic Mist
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Increase by 1 the Defense and Sp. Defense of the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon sprays an ally with a delicate aroma that makes everyone pull their punches against it.

name: Assist
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Copy Move. Choose one Move known by an Ally or member of your party, who may or may not be active in battle. You may choose another Target(s) for the Move. Unique Moves can't be copied.
flavorText: The user hurriedly remembers actions performed by others and mimics them. Some Pokémon can even imitate human tasks and help carry them out.

name: Assurance
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
flavorText: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

name: Astonish
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
flavorText: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

name: Astral Barrage
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique.
flavorText: Call upon the restless spirits of the dead and send them to destroy your opponents. A truly frightening sight to witness.

name: Attack Order
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical.
flavorText: The queen calls her swarm an heeds them to charge against you. No matter where you run, they will surround you. Hope you are not allergic to bees.

name: Attract
addedEffect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
flavorText: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

name: Aura Sphere
addedEffect: Single Target. Never Miss. Projectile Move.
flavorText: By channeling their own aura, the user launches an energy sphere that causes harm on an spiritual level more than a physical one.

name: Aura Wheel
addedEffect: Single Target. Increase the user's Dexterity by 1. If the user of this Move is in "Hangry Form" this Move is considered Dark-Type.
flavorText: The Pokémon happily runs into a wheel made of electricity that strikes the foe. If the user is feeling hungry the wheel’s energy is replaced by a dark aura.

name: Aurora Beam
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce target's Strength by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

name: Aurora Veil
addedEffect: Target User's Side of the Field. Force Field against Physical & Special Damage. This move will fail if not performed under Hail/Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds, even if Hail or Snow Weather is over.
flavorText: If the weather is cold enough, beautiful aurora lights will cover half of the battlefield, deflecting attacks.

name: Autotomize
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2. Halve the User's weight.
flavorText: Rotating parts and tiny gears, the Pokémon works like a welloiled machine.

name: Avalanche
addedEffect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
flavorText: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

name: Axe Kick
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
flavorText: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target leaving it both allured and scared. The heel may break if the kick fails.

name: Baby-Doll Eyes
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
flavorText: The biggest and brightest eyes, spakling with unshed tears, how can you say “no” to that?!

name: Baddy Bad
addedEffect: Single Target. After dealing damage, activate a Force Field against Physical Damage with a Duration of 4 Rounds on the User's side of the Field. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
flavorText: The Pokémon acts like a thug and channels its own dark aura as protection for itself and its allies.

name: Baneful Bunker
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user, Poison the foe.
flavorText: The user encloses themselves inside a sturdy shell covered by poisonous barbs, if a barb pinches the Target’s skin, the wound will start to fester

name: Barb Barrage
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target. *If the Target already has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
flavorText: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

name: Barrage
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon throws whatever objects they find, one after the other to overwhelm the foe.

name: Barrier
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
flavorText: Whenever a foe attempts to to get too close to the user, they suddenly stop as if something ...or someone, prevented their movement.

name: Baton Pass
addedEffect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can't increase its own Attributes again until the end of the scene or until the switched Pokemon faints.
flavorText: The Pokémon rallies through the battle, setting up everything for the next companion as they know this is a team effort.

name: Beak Blast
addedEffect: Single Target. Charge Move. Ranged. Projectile Move. *If the User is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move while this Move is charging, inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the attacker.
flavorText: The Pokémon gets ready to release a boiling gas through its beak, which gets incredibly hot. The resulting blast sounds like a train’s horn.

name: Beat Up
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move for every ally Pokemon that spends an action in addition to this Move, up to 3 allies may join.
flavorText: The user calls other Pokémon to aid it in battle, together they give a beating to the foe.

name: Behemoth Bash
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. *If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax/Gigantamax, This Move becomes Lethal and add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
flavorText: The Pokémon becomes a giant energy shield that pushes back everything in its wake. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all its energy will be swept away

name: Behemoth Blade
addedEffect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Unique. *If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax/Gigantamax, This Move becomes Lethal and add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
flavorText: The Pokémon becomes a giant sword with a razor-sharp blade. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all its energy will be slashed to bits.

name: Belch
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. This Move can only be used if the User has eaten a berry/food during the same Round. Pokemon with this Move may forfeit their Beauty score completely. If the Pokemon forgets this Move, restore 1 Point to their Beauty Score.
flavorText: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

name: Belly Drum
addedEffect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strength by 3.
flavorText: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

name: Bestow
addedEffect: Single Target. Can't be used if Target is not holding an Item. The User gives its Held Item to the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon offers their own item to the foe to show their good manners. The foe keeps it as they don’t want to be seem as impolite.

name: Bide
addedEffect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
flavorText: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

name: Bind
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficultty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses all their strength to restrain to the foe and keep them in place.

name: Bite
addedEffect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
flavorText: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

name: Bitter Blade
addedEffect: Single Target. Cutter Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: The user focuses its bitter feelings towards the world of the living into a slashing attack, seeing the suffering it brings to others makes it feel reinvigorated.

name: Bitter Malice
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Freeze the Foe. *If the Target already has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
flavorText: The victim is hit by an onslaught of evil energy. Filled with dread, the victim is unable to move.

name: Black Hole Eclipse
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Blast Burn
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
flavorText: The Pokémon creates an enormous blast of infernal flames, surviving would be a miracle!

name: Blaze Kick
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. High Critical. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: Setting their legs ablaze, the Pokémon throws a mighty kick that sears the sides of the foe.

name: Blazing Torque
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance dice to inflict 2nd Degee Burn on the Target.
flavorText: The user is spun into a fiery torque with live flames on it!

name: Bleakwind Storm
addedEffect: Area Move. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Freeze those affected.
flavorText: A furious storm ravages the battlefield, cold winds swirl in such a menacing way that you don’t know if the chill comes from the ice or the sheer terror invading you.

name: Blizzard
addedEffect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
flavorText: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

name: Block
addedEffect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: You don’t seem to understand. I’m not blocked in here with you... You are blocked in here with me!

name: Blood Moon
addedEffect: Single Target. If this Move was used on the previous Round, it fails (Clashing counts as using the Move.)
flavorText: The Blood Moon rises once again. When the glow of the bloodstained moon shines upon the land, the aimless spirits of slain monsters return to flesh. The world is threatened once again.

name: Bloom Doom
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Heal 1 HP, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Blue Flare
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: Reshiram surrounds itself with giant blue flame that is unleashed with an earth shattering explosion. Receiving this attack directly might competely engulf you in fire.

name: Body Press
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

name: Body Slam
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
flavorText: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

name: Bolt Beak
addedEffect: Single Target. *If this is the first Action of the Round for the User, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move
flavorText: The Pokémon charges with its beak and pecks its foe. If the foe is not fast enough it will be zapped with a jolt of electricity.

name: Bolt Strike
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe.
flavorText: Zekrom delivers a powerful tackle while discharging lightning through its body. The foe is rendered unable to move, either by the strike of the electricity.

name: Bone Club
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses a bone as a club to to smack their foe, a loud “Bonk!” sound can be heard.

name: Bone Rush
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
flavorText: The foe is assaulted by a series of flurry strikes with a bone club.

name: Bonemerang
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Double Action.
flavorText: The Pokémon throws their bone against the foe, the bone spins in the air and makes a comeback to strike a second time.

name: Boomburst
addedEffect: Area Move. Sound Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon creates a sudden explosive sound that deafens everyone around.

name: Bounce
addedEffect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

name: Bouncy Bubble
addedEffect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down. If the User of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
flavorText: The user shoots bubbles at its target, the bubbles are filled up with fresh water and bounce back towards the user. Should you drink the water inside? Who cares? It’s fun!

name: Branch Poke
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon rudely starts poking its foe with a stick.

name: Brave Bird
addedEffect: Single Target. Recoil.
flavorText: Back in the day humans relied on birds to send their messages and even go to war. Many earned medals for bravery.

name: Breaking Swipe
addedEffect: All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
flavorText: The Pokémon will make a long swipe at using its tail. All foes fall to the ground and come up pretty bruised.

name: Breakneck Blitz
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Brick Break
addedEffect: Single Target. *If there is a Force field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses a karate technique to chop through tall piles of bricks. No matter how many layers you pile up, they’ll break regardless.

name: Brine
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
flavorText: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

name: Brutal Swing
addedEffect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.
flavorText: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws, anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

name: Bubble
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
flavorText: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

name: Bubble Beam
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

name: Bug Bite
addedEffect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
flavorText: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

name: Bug Buzz
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

name: Bulk Up
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
flavorText: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

name: Bulldoze
addedEffect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
flavorText: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

name: Bullet Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
flavorText: You cannot outrun a bullet.

name: Bullet Seed
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Moves.
flavorText: The Pokémon starts shooting seed as if they were a machine gun.

name: Burn Up
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. After damage is dealt, the user loses its Fire-Type. If its only type was Fire, it is now Typeless. User's Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the User.
flavorText: The User unleashes all of its might through a massive blast of raging fire. Although the damage is devastating the Pokémon is left unable to produce more fire for a while.

name: Burning Bulwark
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move, inflicct 1st Degree Burn to it.
flavorText: The Pokémon lights a fire coat around itself as a protective barrier. It is not a good idea to touch it.

name: Burning Jealousy
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. *Inflict 1st Degree Burn on all affected Targets with Increased Attributes.
flavorText: The user can’t stand the idea that others are better than them. Their jealousy manifests in the form of a fiery aura that sticks to those the user despises de most.

name: Buzzy Buzz
addedEffect: Single Target. Paralyze the foe. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
flavorText: The Pokémon releases a jolt of static electricity from its fur, that makes a cute zapping sound. It’s all fun and games until somebody gets paralyzed.

name: Calm Mind
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The Pokémon takes a deep breath to increase the mental fortitude required to face any problem.

name: Camouflage
addedEffect: Target Self. For the rest of the scene the User changes type to one that fits the terrain/ environment it is in (ie User is in a rocky cave, becoming rock type).
flavorText: The Pokémon blends with their surroundings to increase their chances of survival.

name: Captivate
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 2 the Special of those affected.
flavorText: The Pokémon shows off their attractiveness and even flirts with the opponents, those who fall for their charms can’t keep focus on the battle.

name: Ceaseless Edge
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical. Cutter Move. Ongoing Damage with Duration of 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The user slashes the foe using a sharp but brittle shell. Tiny spikes from the shell are left embeded into the foe’s wounds causing more damage as the foe moves.

name: Charge
addedEffect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
flavorText: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

name: Charge Beam
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Increase User's Special by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon releases an electric beam, if any charge remains unused, it will make use of it to boost its power.

name: Charm
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
flavorText: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

name: Chatter
addedEffect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon parrots the voice of a human and starts issuing silly commands to the foe. This quickly becomes confusing for the foe.

name: Chilling Water
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon douses cold water in the head of their foe in order to make them think straight. Surprisingly, it works.

name: Chilly Reception
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Switcher Move For the User. Activate Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds. Pokemon with this Move may forfeit their Cool score completely. If the Pokemon forgets this Move, restore 1 Point to their Cool Score.
flavorText: “What did a Geodude say to another Geodude? Let’s Rock!” The User tells a joke so terrible the whole battlefield freezes. Afterwards, the user retreats in shame.

name: Chip Away
addedEffect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
flavorText: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

name: Chloroblast
addedEffect: Single Target. Recoil.
flavorText: The Pokémon concentrates all of the chlorophyll inside of their body to make it explode. Targets are tinted green for days afterwards.

name: Circle Throw
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy -1. Late Reaction 1. Switcher Move for the foe.
flavorText: Using their best sumo moves, the Pokémon throws the foe 60ft. out of the battlefield.

name: Clamp
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Block both User and Target. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: Lured by a beautiful pearl, the target is clamped by the user’s sturdy shell. The user will not release the target until they no longer feel movement.

name: Clanging Scales
addedEffect: Target all Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce User's Defense by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon rattles the scales of its armor creating a frightening noise in the area. Some of its scales fall off as a result, leaving some areas exposed.

name: Clangorous Soul
addedEffect: Target Self. User deals Damage Dice to itself equal to Half of its Total HP rounded down. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The Pokémon shakes its scales around, to sharpen, shed, and rearrange them. It’s a bit rough, but in the end the Pokémon feels more focused for battle.

name: Clash
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 6. Match the number of successes on the Accuracy roll of a Move that targets the User. If successful, the user Clashes, see p.68. This Maneuver is not affected by the Multiple Action difficulty chart.
flavorText: A power struggle can become a clash of mights, usually with explosive results.

name: Clear Smog
addedEffect: Single Target. Never Miss. Reset all Increased or Reduced Attributes on the Foe.
flavorText: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

name: Close Combat
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The Pokémon gets close enough to deal devastating damage, but the same can be said for the foe.

name: Coaching
addedEffect: Target All Allies in Range. Increase by 1 the Strength and Defense of all Allies targeted. The User cannot target itself.
flavorText: This Pokémon allies form a line and start doing squats and push-ups while the user corrects their form and gives them tips and a confidence boost to win this match.

name: Coil
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense score and Accuracy Pools.
flavorText: The Pokémon curls up into themselves. Foes soon realize this is not the position of a prey in hiding, but of a hunter about to spit their venom.

name: Collision Course
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *Add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target is weak to Fight-Type Moves.
flavorText: Koraidon dashes through the field with a screeching sound, it will not stop until it violently crashes. Causing a massive prehistoric explosion.

name: Combat Torque
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance dice to Paralyze the Target.
flavorText: After shaking and beating their target up, the user will attempt to immovilize them.

name: Comet Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Successive Actions.
flavorText: A series of rapid punches. So fast they leace a luminous trail behind like a comet’s.

name: Comeuppance
addedEffect: Single Target. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice.
flavorText: An eye for en eye, the user retaliates with a vengance against those who cross them.

name: Confide
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Special by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon tells a secret to the target. They giggle together but the foe loses its concentration on the battle.

name: Confuse Ray
addedEffect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
flavorText: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

name: Confusion
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
flavorText: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

name: Constrict
addedEffect: Single Target. This Move deals Typeless damage. Roll 1 chance die to reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon tightens their hold on the foe to keep them locked in a squeeze.

name: Continental Crush
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Remove Terrain, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Contrict
addedEffect: Single Target. This Move deals Typeless Damage. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.

name: Conversion
addedEffect: Target Self. Unique. Change the User's Main Type at random. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon downloads data from their database to add into their own code.

name: Conversion 2
addedEffect: Target Self. Unique. After being dealt damage by a Physical or Special Move, change the User's Main Type to a Type resistant to that Move. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon downloads data from a Move that was used against it and changes their code to resist future attacks.

name: Copycat
addedEffect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
flavorText: The user is incredibly observant and has a talent for impersonations, no one will tell the difference!

name: Core Enforcer
addedEffect: Single Target. If the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round, Remove the Target's Ability for the rest of the scene. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities are not affected by this effect.
flavorText: Zygarde shoots a beam that fractures the target to its core, rendering it unable to sustain even their own essence.

name: Corkscrew Crash
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Ignore Ability, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Corrosive Gas
addedEffect: Area Attack. Those affected lose their held item.
flavorText: The Pokémon releases a powerful acidic gas that melts all inorganic matter in seconds.

name: Cosmic Power
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The Pokémon elevates their cosmos to enhance their physical and mental fortitude.

name: Cotton Guard
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 3.
flavorText: The Pokémon grows a lush coat of cotton puffs. The cotton greatly reduces all kinds of impact.

name: Cotton Spore
addedEffect: Single Target. Powder Move. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
flavorText: The foe is covered head to toe in cotton fluff, disrupting its movement.

name: Counter
addedEffect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
flavorText: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

name: Court Change
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Swap any Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Effects on the Foe's side of the field (ie Tailwind, Grassy Terrain healing, Fire Pledge.) for those on the User's side.
flavorText: The Pokémon signals the referee for half-time, the referee complies and both parties swap their sides of the field. Wait... we brought everything with us, right?

name: Cover An Ally
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The User will become the Target for incoming attacks towards the Target. This Cover lasts until the User's Next Turn or until the Target uses a Non-Ranged Physical Move. Pokémon with Loyalty 2 or less won't use this Maneuver.
flavorText: Use your body as a shield to protect your friends! Not even 100 Spearrows will go through you!

name: Covet
addedEffect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.
flavorText: The Pokémon is attracted to shiny and colorful items. They don’t understand when something is not theirs for the taking so they just take it when no one is looking.

name: Crabhammer
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. High Critical
flavorText: The Pokémon uses their powerful claws to beat down any foe. There’s a reason seafood is not too popular in this world.

name: Crafty Shield
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Negate the Added Effects from Moves made against the Targets.
flavorText: The Pokémon creates a magic shield to protect everyone from any tricks a foe has up their sleeve. Under this shield, everyone can see dishonesty and bad intentions

name: Cross Chop
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical.
flavorText: The Pokémon delivers a chop with crossed arms, a quite impractical but extremely cool technique.

name: Cross Poison
addedEffect: Single Target. Cutter Move. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon releases a powerful acidic gas that melts all inorganic matter in seconds.

name: Crunch
addedEffect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

name: Crush Claw
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
flavorText: With a crushing grip against the foe, the user manages to break their armor.

name: Crush Grip
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the foe has an HP higher than 4, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool for every exceeding point. Up to 9 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The Pokémon grips the foe and starts crushing it. Small targets are difficult to grasp but larger bodies will not be released until they break.

name: Curse
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
flavorText: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

name: Curse (Non-Ghost)
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense. Reduce by 1 the User's Dexterity. This effect only works if the User is not Ghost-Type.

name: Cut
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Out of battle it will help to easily cut down trees and obstacles.
flavorText: A swift and precise cut that can even slice a tree in half.

name: Dark Pulse
addedEffect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

name: Dark Void
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range. Low Accuracy 3. Put those affected to Sleep.
flavorText: A portal opens and transports all foes to a world of darkness, inside they can’t see or feel anything, it’s like they are trapped in an eternal slumber.

name: Darkest Lariat
addedEffect: Single Target. Ignore Defenses.
flavorText: The user swings both of its arms against the target, there’s no armor thick enough to stop this cruel strike.

name: Dazzling Gleam
addedEffect: Target All foes in Range.
flavorText: The Pokémon shines bright like a diamond. The powerful flash hurts the eyes of everyone watching.

name: Decorate
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Increase by 2 the Strength and Special of the Target.
flavorText: With just a bit of cake frosting the Pokémon decorates their target to look bigger, more powerful and incredibly delicious!

name: Defend Order
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense and Sp. Defense by 1.
flavorText: A swarm of bugs flies around the user, creating a barrier to protect their swarm queen from damage.

name: Defense Curl
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
flavorText: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

name: Defog
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
flavorText: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

name: Destiny Bond
addedEffect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
flavorText: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

name: Detect
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
flavorText: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

name: Devastating Drake
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Sound Move, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Diamond Storm
addedEffect: All foes in range. Ranged. Roll 5 chance dice to increase the user's defense by 2.
flavorText: The Pokémon summons a storm of diamonds over the field. These diamonds also serve as barriers the user can take cover into.

name: Dig
addedEffect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
flavorText: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

name: Dire Claw
addedEffect: Single Target. High Critical. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Poison the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to put the Target to Sleep.
flavorText: The Pokémon makes a cut on their victim with claws drenched in venom; then patiently stalks it, waiting for the toxins to wear it out.

name: Disable
addedEffect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
flavorText: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

name: Disarming Voice
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.
flavorText: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

name: Discharge
addedEffect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
flavorText: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

name: Dive
addedEffect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.
flavorText: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

name: Dizzy Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon locates their enemy’s balance point and lands a swift punch that leaves the foe seeing a swirl of stars around its head.

name: Doodle
addedEffect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
flavorText: By doodling a quick drawing of their target the doodle somehow allows the Pokémon to make use of the depicted creature’s powers.

name: Doom Desire
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Rund. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute decoys. If the target retires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies. Extra effects may be added at Storyteller's Discretion.
flavorText: Be careful what you wish for, this Pokémon will read your most intimate wishes and make them come true in very twisted ways.

name: Double Hit
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses the true and tested “one-two”.

name: Double Iron Bash
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Unique. Double Action. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe after each hit. This Move may only Flinch once.
flavorText: The user hardens its limbs and then rotates them at great speed to hit the foe twice in a row. The blow can leave the victim crushed on the floor.

name: Double Kick
addedEffect: Single Target. Double Action.
flavorText: The good old one-two but with a twist.

name: Double Shock
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. After damage is dealt, the user loses its Electric-Type. If its only type was Electric, it is now Typeless. User's Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the User.
flavorText: The user lets out a colossal discharge of electricity, lightning connecting the sky and earth for way too long. However, the effort effectively depletes the energy reserves of the user.

name: Double Slap
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
flavorText: The name is misleading as the user slaps withouth even counting how many slaps they have given already

name: Double Team
addedEffect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
flavorText: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

name: Double-Edge
addedEffect: Single Target. Recoil.
flavorText: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

name: Draco Meteor
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
flavorText: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

name: Dragon Ascent
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The user rises above the clouds and then comes crashing down against its foe in an instant. The strike is brutal for the both of them.

name: Dragon Breath
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
flavorText: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

name: Dragon Cheer
addedEffect: Target Allies in Range. All Physical and Special Moves of the Allies now have the "High Critical" Added Effect. *If an Ally is a Dragon-Type, Increase their Strength and Special by 1.
flavorText: With a mighty roar, the Pokémon fires up the battle spirit of their companions on their quest for victory.

name: Dragon Claw
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

name: Dragon Dance
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
flavorText: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

name: Dragon Darts
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. Double Action.
flavorText: The Pokémon’s head is a nest for its less evolved forms, the younglings will sometimes be used as projectiles.

name: Dragon Energy
addedEffect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal. *Reduce 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 dice may be removed this way.
flavorText: The Pokémon converts its life-energy into a life-ending beam. No exaggeration.

name: Dragon Hammer
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon swings its body as a hammer and leaves the foe nailed to the cracked ground.

name: Dragon Pulse
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

name: Dragon Rage
addedEffect: Single Target. Set Damage. Deal 2 Dragon-Type Damage to the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon focuses their inner rage and makes it not-soinner anymore.

name: Dragon Rush
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

name: Dragon Tail
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
flavorText: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

name: Drain Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

name: Draining Kiss
addedEffect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: The Pokémon blows a flirtatious kiss; the foe catches it believing to have found love, but it turns out to be a trick to steal its life energy.

name: Dream Eater
addedEffect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition, otherwise it will fail. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: The Pokémon enters the dream world for a snack. The dreams of children and baby Pokémon are the tastiest.

name: Drill Peck
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal.
flavorText: A bird has no fangs, yet they can still can tear flesh.

name: Drill Run
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
flavorText: The Pokémon holds their claws together and starts spinning as if they were a drill. They can puncture a hole into any surface from walls and floors to their foes.

name: Drum Beating
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon has a perfectly good drum and you’d think it would use it. But it doesn’t, It uses it’s foe.

name: Dual Chop
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
flavorText: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

name: Dual Wingbeat
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double action.
flavorText: The Pokémon slams the foe from above. Each wing provides a good smacking.

name: Dynamax Cannon
addedEffect: Single Target. *If the Target is under the effects of Dynamax, this Move becomes Lethal and you add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots a heavy projectile, if the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all the energy will be concentrated and explode on the Target.

name: Dynamic Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Fist Move. Confuse the Target.
flavorText: A punch to a vital pressure point on the foe to disrupt their sense of balance

name: Earth Power
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
flavorText: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

name: Earthquake
addedEffect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
flavorText: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

name: Echoed Voice
addedEffect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
flavorText: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

name: Eerie Impulse
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Special by 2.
flavorText: The user radiates electricity around itself so the foe will think twice about attacking.

name: Eerie Spell
addedEffect: Single Target. Sound Move. Target spends 3 Will points without any benefit, this effect does not stack.
flavorText: The Pokémon mutters ancient spell, forbidden words break the spirit to make the victim easier to manipulate.

name: Egg Bomb
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Projectile Move.
flavorText: The target can’t take a yolk. Let’s make them laugh with an egg-cellent pun to crack them up.

name: Electric Terrain
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The user electrifies the battlefield, making it impossible to relax around the sparks and live current.

name: Electrify
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. All Damage of the Next Physical or Special Move the Target performs will become Electric-Type
flavorText: The user hurls a sudden electric jolt onto its target. The target’s is now charged and will need to release the excess energy through an attack.

name: Electro Ball
addedEffect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
flavorText: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

name: Electro Drift
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *Add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target is weak to Electric-Type Moves.
flavorText: Miraidon accelerates its turbines and races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target in a blast of futuristic electricity

name: Electro Shot
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Charge Move. If Rain Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge acton. Increase the User's Special Score by 1.
flavorText: The user stands as tall as possible, waiting for a lightning to strike. Then re-directs the lightning directly towards the foe; recharging themselves in the process.

name: Electroweb
addedEffect: Target All foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
flavorText: An electrified web is shot towards the target, shoking and tangling them at the same time.

name: Embargo
addedEffect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The user demands the held item of a Pokémon and the items in the bag of their trainer. Scared, both Pokémon and Trainer comply

name: Ember
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

name: Encore
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
flavorText: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

name: Endeavor
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
flavorText: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

name: Endure
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

name: Energy Ball
addedEffect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
flavorText: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

name: Entrainment
addedEffect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
flavorText: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

name: Eruption
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. *Reduce 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 dice may be removed this way.
flavorText: A fierce burst of lava comes out from the Pokémon at full force, charring whatever comes in contact with it. The lava flow diminishes as the rage subsides.

name: Esper Wing
addedEffect: Single Target. High Critical. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: The User slashes the foe with psychic energy channeled through their wings. This energy also allows it to cut through the air and fly faster.

name: Eternabeam
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots an incredibly powerful beam towards the sky. The energy released might keep traveling through space thousands of years later.

name: Evasion
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 6. Match the number of successes on the Accuracy roll of a Move that targets the User. If successful, the user Evades, see p.68. This Maneuver is not affected by the Multiple Action difficulty chart.
flavorText: No time to think! If you hear "Dooooooodge!" You get out of the way A.S.A.P

name: Expanding Force
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Psychic Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move and you may add another target to it.
flavorText: Psychic energies form a bubble of light to damage the foe. Under Psychic Terrain, the energy is so big it turns into a tall pillar that crushes anyone inside.

name: Explosion
addedEffect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
flavorText: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

name: Extrasensory
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

name: Extreme Speed
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 2. Out of battle, triple the Pokemon's movement speed.
flavorText: Gotta go extremely fast.

name: Facade
addedEffect: Single Target. *If the User has a Status Ailment (Paralysis, Poison, Burn, etc.) Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool.
flavorText: The Pokémon puts on a brave face through the most difficult of situations.

name: Fairy Lock
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Block. Duration 1 Round.
flavorText: The User moves as if locking a door, preventing anyone from leaving the room. It takes everyone a few seconds to realize they are not really trapped.

name: Fairy Wind
addedEffect: Single Target. Wind Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon let’s out sweet a breeze of glittery fairy dust. It gives a mild rash to those without happy thoughts.

name: Fake Out
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
flavorText: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

name: Fake Tears
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
flavorText: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

name: False Surrender
addedEffect: Single Target. Never Miss.
flavorText: The Pokémon bows down in defeat, begging for forgiveness; then backstabs the guillible foe.

name: False Swipe
addedEffect: Single Target. Cutter Move. This Move's Damage can't make the Target go below 1 HP.
flavorText: Through their most dramatic poses, the Pokémon pretends to slice up the foe (the blood is fake).

name: Feather Dance
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 2.
flavorText: A dance as soft as a feather. It soothes the hearts of the spectators and reduces all aggression.

name: Feint
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Late Reaction 1. This Move may be used as a Reaction or as a Late Reaction at convenience of the User. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
flavorText: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

name: Feint Attack
addedEffect: Single Target. Never Miss.
flavorText: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

name: Fell Stinger
addedEffect: Single Target. *If used against a fainted Target ot if the Target faints due to damage from this Move, Increase the User’s Strength by 2.
flavorText: The Pokémon stings the target, if the foe is too weakened to move, the user absorbs their power.

name: Fickle Beam
addedEffect: Single Target Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power.
flavorText: The Pokémon is formed by many individual heads who rarely agree with one another, but when they do their combined power is devastating.

name: Fiery Dance
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Increase User's Special by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon cloaks themselves in flames while dancing with graceful passion. The flames are scattered and the user feels reinvigorated.

name: Fiery Wrath
addedEffect: Target all Foes in Range. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
flavorText: The Pokémon’s wrath is turned to flames that consume the foe’s body and soul.

name: Fillet Away
addedEffect: Target Self. Deal 2 Damage to the User. Increase the User's Strength, Dexterity and Special by 2.
flavorText: The Pokémon slices pieces of itself to sharpen out the edges and give themselves a more hydrodynamic shape.

name: Final Gambit
addedEffect: Single Target. Ignore Defenses. The user Faints after dealing Damage.
flavorText: The Pokémon puts its last Strength into an all-or-nothing attack. After that, the user faints.

name: Fire Blast
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots a giant fireball that explodes as soon as it touches their target. Blasting fire in all directions.

name: Fire Fang
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

name: Fire Lash
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce Foe's Defense by 1.
flavorText: With a whip of fire, the Pokémon ensnares its foe, who is left defenseless and at its mercy

name: Fire Pledge
addedEffect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: At the End of the Round, Roll 2 Dice of Fire-Type Damage to everyone without immunity to Ground on the field ignoring defenses. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of fire, their pledge is heard and the flames come forward to aid them in battle.

name: Fire Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

name: Fire Spin
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
flavorText: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

name: First Impression
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 2. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. From the second round on, it will fail automatically.
flavorText: The Pokémon makes a dramatic entrance to the battlefield, taking the foe by surprise.

name: Fishious Rend
addedEffect: Single Target. Bite Move. *If this is the first Action of the Round for the User, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
flavorText: This Pokémon uses their gills to snap at its target. Even if they don’t have teeth, their jaws have a crushing strength.

name: Fissure
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damge. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
flavorText: The earth rips apart underneath the target and swallows them whole. You’ll need a rescue team to recover the unlucky victim from the deep.

name: Flail
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

name: Flame Burst
addedEffect: Single Target. After dealing damage, the User may roll 1 die of Fire-Type Damage against two other targets, ignoring defenses.
flavorText: A compact fireball that bursts just as it hits the foe, scattering smaller flames to unsuspecting bystanders.

name: Flame Charge
addedEffect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

name: Flame Wheel
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: The user surrounds themselves with fire, then curl into a ball and runs over the target in a fiery spin.

name: Flamethrower
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

name: Flare Blitz
addedEffect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: A reckless blazing charge against their foe, ends up with an explosive collision

name: Flash
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon glows with a bright light to temporarily blind and dazzle their foe. It’s also perfect to light up dark places.

name: Flash Cannon
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
flavorText: Through shiny metal parts of their body, the Pokémon reflects a light beam straight into the foe’s eyes.

name: Flatter
addedEffect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
flavorText: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

name: Fleur Cannon
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Unique. Reduce User's Special by 2.
flavorText: A light beam pierces the battlefield, it deals devastating damage but leaves newly grown flowers instead of scorched earth. The user is left feeling very tired.

name: Fling
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. *If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. User loses its Held Item. See p. 530
flavorText: The Pokémon takes their held item, uses it as a weapon and the referee is somehow OK with this. The held item remains in the field and may be recovered after the battle.

name: Flip Turn
addedEffect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
flavorText: Charge at the foe as a cannon ball made out of water. The big splash causes bystanders to lose sight on the battlefield. When the splash settles, the user is gone.

name: Floaty Fall
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user of this Movve is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
flavorText: With the help of 99 air balloons, the user jumps up high and falls on top of its foe. The use of 99 balloons in-battle is questionable, but the referee will allow them.

name: Floral Healing
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If Performed over Grassy Terrain this move is a Complete Heal.
flavorText: The user creates a flower crown that heals and relaxes its wearer. Under the right conditions this move also creates a flower patch around its target.

name: Flower Shield
addedEffect: Target battlefield. Increase by 1 the Defense of all Grass-Type Pokemon.
flavorText: The whole field grows flowers and those flowers keep growing on top of all Grass-Type Pokémon in the field, providing a mild cover and protection from harm.

name: Flower Trick
addedEffect: Single Target. Never Miss. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
flavorText: The user throws a bouquet of flowers at the target, who holds them close believing them to be a gift, only to realize the bouquet were flower bombs.

name: Fly
addedEffect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to fly long distances.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses an action to fly up high, to asses the best angle to take a dive against the foe. Pokémon who know this Move can fly for long periods of time without rest.

name: Flying Press
addedEffect: Single Target. This move deals damage as if it was also Flying-Type.
flavorText: The user jumps up the ropes to hit the foe using their knees in pure Lucha Libre style!

name: Focus Blast
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense by 1.
flavorText: A powerful energy blast that requires the user to chant each syllabe of the technique’s name and release it by yelling “Haaaaa!”

name: Focus Energy
addedEffect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

name: Focus Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Charge Move. The User Flinches if it is hit while Charging this Move.
flavorText: The user must focus on delivering the greatest punch in history, if they succeed they’ll be known as the One-Punch Pokémon.

name: Follow Me
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 4. All Foe's Moves able to do so will Target the user. Duration 1 Round.
flavorText: The Pokemon draws everyone’s attention, provoking their foes to do their worse.

name: Force Palm
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
flavorText: A powerful open-palm hit that knocks the foe several feet away and may leave them unable to move.

name: Foresight
addedEffect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses their honed senses and mental agility to predict the next movement of their foe.

name: Forest's Curse
addedEffect: Single Target. Add the Grass Type to the Target's Type. (ie Pikachu will now be "Electric/Grass", Charizard will not be "Fire/Flying/Grass") If the Target already has a third Type attached, replace it.
flavorText: The user lays the forest’scurse upon the target, causing roots and branches to grow on its body until they are a haunted tree. Perform an exorcism or get to a Pokémon Center ASAP

name: Foul Play
addedEffect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.
flavorText: The user feints an attack that tricks the foe into hurting itself.

name: Freeze Dry
addedEffect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.
flavorText: All moisture is frozen and then subjected to high pressure, evaporating it immediately. Water-type Pokémon suffer this Move the most.

name: Freeze Shock
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
flavorText: The user appears to become a block of ice, then releases itself from the ice with a devastating discharge. The exploding ice shards and the lightning fly all over the battlefield.

name: Freezing Glare
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots freakin’ laser beams from its freakin’ eyes against everything that moves...until nothing does.

name: Freezy Frost
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits the Target may have. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
flavorText: The user touches its foe while saying “Freeze!”, surprisingly, the foe becomes frozen on a block of ice that melts as soon as the foe realizes it was just a game.

name: Frenzy Plant
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge.
flavorText: The user roots down and calls upon the force of nature. Thorny roots and plants grow in a frenzy around the foe. This display of power leaves the user quite exhausted.

name: Frost Breath
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. This Move is always considered to be a Critical hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
flavorText: The user locates the most exposed parts of its foe and sends a gelid breath against it. The sudden chill goes right through the foe’s spine.

name: Frustration
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing point of Happiness on the user. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: A mistreated Pokémon grows vicious and uncaring, a Move fueled by anger.

name: Fury Attack
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
flavorText: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

name: Fury Cutter
addedEffect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

name: Fury Swipes
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
flavorText: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

name: Fusion Bolt
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the Move "Fusion Flare" has already been used by anyone this Round, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon strikes with a devastating electric impact, said impact will grow larger and stronger if there’s a special kind of fire nearby.

name: Fusion Flare
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the Move "Fusion Bolt" has already been used by anyone this Round, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon sets ablaze a swirling pillar upon the target, said pillar will grow taller and swirl faster if there’s a special kind of charge nearby.

name: Future Sight
addedEffect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
flavorText: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

name: Gastro Acid
addedEffect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

name: Gear Grind
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
flavorText: The foe gets trapped into two gears, the only way out is to let the gears grind against its crushed body.

name: Gear Up
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Increase by 1 the Strength and Spcial of one Steel-Type of Electric-Type Ally.
flavorText: The Pokémon performs a basic manteniance on their ally. A change of oil and filters, new spark plugs, and the ally is more than ready!

name: Geomancy
addedEffect: Target Self. Charge Move. Unique. Increase by 2 the User's Dexterity, Special and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: Through a mystical conection this Pokémon absorbs the life force of earth itself to increase its power.

name: Giga Drain
addedEffect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

name: Giga Impact
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
flavorText: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

name: Gigaton Hammer
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round. *This Move may deal 2 Extra Damage Dice to Steel-Type Pokemon at Storyteller's Discretion.
flavorText: When you have a hammer everything is a nail.

name: Gigavolt Havoc
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Paralyze, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Glacial Lance
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique.
flavorText: It looks just like any other Blizzard until the ice spears start raining straight into you.

name: Glaciate
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those Affected. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Freeze those Affected.
flavorText: The air is so cold it hurts to move, to see, to breath. Escaping should be your top priority, for every second you don’t your life will be at peril.

name: Glaive Rush
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. The User is now Vulnerable to: The Next Physical or Special Move that targets them.
flavorText: The user attacks with its sharp dorsal fin by doing a somersault slash. This can pretty much slice in half anything, but it also leaves the user prone to sneak attacks.

name: Glare
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Paralyze the Target.
flavorText: With just one look, the target knows it is about to be someone else’s lunch, fear has them immobilized.

name: Glitzy Glow
