addedEffect: Single Target. After dealing damage, activate a Force Field against Special Damage with a Duration of 4 Rounds on the User's side of the Field. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
flavorText: The user surrounds themselves with a glamorous light and shoots a psychic blast, the glowing particles remain in the field protecting their fabulousness.

name: Grapple
addedEffect: Single Target. Blocks. The Target may resist this Maneuver by rolling Strength or Dexterity and scoring the same or more Successes than the User. The User can't Act while Grappling. The User can release the Grapple at any point to act.
flavorText: Force the target into a wrestling lock; use a lasso rodeo-style; or simply cling onto one of their legs — the point is: you won’t let them escape!

name: Grass Knot
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The user snares the foe’s feet with a grass tangle to make it fall into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

name: Grass Pledge
addedEffect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Target's that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
flavorText: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of grass, their pledge is heard and the ground crumbles as vegetation grapples and traps everyone in the field.

name: Grass Whistle
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
flavorText: A soothing and relaxing melody created with the sounds of nature. It is a very subtle tone, so it may be hard to listen.

name: Grassy Glide
addedEffect: Single Target. *If Grassy Terrain is active, this Move has Reaction 1.
flavorText: A single leaf can hold the entire weight of the Pokémon. When moving, it appears to glide over the grass.

name: Grassy Terrain
addedEffect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

name: Grav Apple
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon rises on top of its foe and drops an apple on their head. The foe proceeds to eat the apple, distracting it from the fight.

name: Gravity
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Remove the immunity to Ground-Type Moves for everyone in the field. Moves that require jumping or flying get an Extra "Low Accuracy 2". Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: An invisisible force pulls everyone to the floor keeps them from taking off the ground.

name: Growl
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
flavorText: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

name: Growth
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
flavorText: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

name: Grudge
addedEffect: Single Target. The User Faints. Reduce the Target's Will to 0 points and reset any effect it got from spending them. Roll Target's Loyalty at the end of the round, increase difficulty by 1 each round. Failing this roll faints the Target.
flavorText: The last words of this Pokémon imprint their grudge and anger over their foe. Depleting the foe of their will to carry on in this world.

name: Guard Split
addedEffect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
flavorText: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

name: Guard Swap
addedEffect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's.
flavorText: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its fortitude and implant on them the idea of their own weakness.

name: Guillotine
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
flavorText: Fueled by the spirit of revolution the Pokémon sentences their foe to be reduced at the neck. This devastating attack requires an emergency trip to the Pokémon Center...and a basket.

name: Gunk Shot
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
flavorText: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

name: Gust
addedEffect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
flavorText: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

name: Gyro Ball
addedEffect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

name: Hail
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

name: Hammer Arm
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

name: Hard Press
addedEffect: Single Target. *Reduce 1 Die from the Damage Pool for every missing Hp the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be removed this way.
flavorText: The foe is grappled in a painful lock, the more it struggles to get out the more pressure it’s gonna feel. The user must be on top condition for this grapple to be effective.

name: Harden
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
flavorText: When life gets hard, do the same.

name: Haze
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
flavorText: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

name: Head Charge
addedEffect: Single Target. Recoil.
flavorText: The Pokémon is headstrong, in head-to-head competitions they will always charge head on.

name: Head Smash
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
flavorText: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

name: Headbutt
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
flavorText: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

name: Headlong Rush
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: This Pokémon is headstrong in a very very literal way.

name: Heal Bell
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Cure any Status Ailment on the Targets.
flavorText: The soothing chime of a magical bell cleanses all impurities.

name: Heal Block
addedEffect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

name: Heal Order
addedEffect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
flavorText: The queen commands the swarm to bring her healing honey.

name: Heal Pulse
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
flavorText: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

name: Healing Wish
addedEffect: Target Self. The user faints. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
flavorText: In a display of true selflessness, the user makes the ultimate sacrifice for the well-being of others.

name: Heart Stamp
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon controls the emotions of their victims just as they start to feel loved and safe, the Pokémon strikes. The poor victim is left broken hearted for a few seconds.

name: Heart Swap
addedEffect: Single Target. Switch the User's Trait and Attribute Increases and Reductions with those on the Target's.
flavorText: The User enters the mind of the foe to give implant them with their own feelings of insecurity and take the foe’s feelings of confidence in itself.

name: Heat Crash
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die of Damage for every 50kgs the User is above the Target. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The Pokémon sets themselves ablaze and dives a cannonball against their foe.

name: Heat Wave
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
flavorText: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

name: Heavy Slam
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

name: Help Another
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. Roll your Accuracy as if it were Chance dice. Add 1 die to the Accuracy Roll of your Ally for each Success (result of 6) obtained this way. Up to 3 Characters may attempt to help a single Action. Up to 6 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: Not being the best suited for a task doesn’t mean you won’t do your part in helping out. The best teams work together!

name: Helping Hand
addedEffect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
flavorText: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

name: Hex
addedEffect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
flavorText: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

name: Hidden Power
addedEffect: Single Target. This Move will always deal Super-Effective Damage against the Target. If used by the Pokemon #201 Unown. See p. 530
flavorText: Inside every Pokémon lies the key to unlock all kinds of power.

name: High Horsepower
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon tramples their foe without mercy. Their powerful body could pull a traction vehicle for very long distances.

name: High Jump Kick
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 5 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
flavorText: The user launches itself up three stories high to pummel down with a brutal kick. Let’s just trust it’s got a good aim from that distance.

name: Hold Hands
addedEffect: Single Target. The battle may end at the Storyteller's discretion. Target may resist rolling their Will Score against the Accuracy of this Move. Out of battle, aid to reduce hostile intent.
flavorText: The user offers their hand in friendship, if the other Pokémon holds their hand they’ll be very happy and become good friends.

name: Hone Claws
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength score and Accuracy Pools.
flavorText: Sharp claws make for more precise and deadly attacks.

name: Horn Attack
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: The user has horns. Did you not expect they’ll use them?

name: Horn Drill
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
flavorText: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

name: Horn Leech
addedEffect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: The user rams into the foe and uses the leaves growing on their horns to absorb nutrients from it.

name: Howl
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Increase by 1 the Strength of those affected.
flavorText: If you hear the howl, the pack has already surrounded you.

name: Hurricane
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
flavorText: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

name: Hydro Cannon
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge
flavorText: Those who fear fire’s destructive power have forgotten that water triumphs over the flames every single time.

name: Hydro Pump
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
flavorText: Water works best under pressure.

name: Hydro Steam
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. *If Sunny Weather is active, this Move does not reduce damage due to it, and has 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
flavorText: When water and fire work together you’ll wish they didn’t set aside their differences.

name: Hydro Vortex
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Hyper Beam
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
flavorText: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

name: Hyper Drill
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Ignore Shield Moves active on the Foe or their side of the field.
flavorText: Using their tail as a powerful drill, the Pokémon pierces through any surface it comes in contact with.

name: Hyper Fang
addedEffect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon bites hard into the foe, leaving nasty teeth marks.

name: Hyper Voice
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
flavorText: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

name: Hyperspace Fury
addedEffect: Single Target. Never Miss. Ignores the effect of any Force Field or Shield Move active on the foe's side. Reduce the User's Defense by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon opens portals to attack with each one of its arms, bypassing all defenses and making it impossible to escape; however, portals go both ways.

name: Hyperspace Hole
addedEffect: Single Target. Never Miss. Unique. Ignore Defenses. Ignore Shield Moves and Force Field.
flavorText: The laws of physics forbid one object from being in many places at once and from occupying the same space as other bodies. But the user disregards their autorithy.

name: Hypnosis
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
flavorText: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

name: Ice Ball
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
flavorText: The Pokémon rolls into a snowball, getting bigger and bigger as they keep rolling

name: Ice Beam
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

name: Ice Burn
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Charge Move. Unique. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: The user appears to become a block of ice, then it releases themselves from the ice with a devastating explosion. The exploding ice shards and fire blow all over the battlefield.

name: Ice Fang
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

name: Ice Hammer
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses its powerful gelid arms and strikes the foe with a swing motion.

name: Ice Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

name: Ice Shard
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
flavorText: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

name: Ice Spinner
addedEffect: Single Target. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
flavorText: The user covers their feet with sharp ice blades and skates through the field making gracious spins to hit the target. The battlefield ends up cut by the blades though.

name: Icicle Crash
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon creates a big stalactite on top of the foe and lets it fall on top of it. Sometimes they manage to impale the foe to the ground.

name: Icicle Spear
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions.
flavorText: A barrage of icicles shot against the target. They are small but sharp and pointy

name: Icy Wind
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
flavorText: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

name: Imprison
addedEffect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
flavorText: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

name: Incinerate
addedEffect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.
flavorText: A small blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

name: Infernal Parade
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Foe. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
flavorText: 'You may not be the type to faint when things are odd or things are quaint. But seeing flames you know that ain’t will scorch you into dismay't will scorch you into dismay.'

name: Inferno
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Lethal. Inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: The user sets their target on fire with unforgiving flames. Abandon all hope.

name: Inferno Overdrive
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Infestation
addedEffect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
flavorText: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

name: Ingrain
addedEffect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

name: Instruct
addedEffect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon sends a psychic command to a target, enabling the user to mentally tell them what to do. If you see a Pokémon attacking their own allies... this was it.

name: Ion Deluge
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Damage from Normal-Type Moves will be considered to be Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The user electrifies all the particles in the environment with shocking results!

name: Iron Defense
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
flavorText: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

name: Iron Head
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

name: Iron Tail
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
flavorText: With a hardened tail, the Pokémon swings against the foe to make a dent in their armor.

name: Ivy Cudgel
addedEffect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible Otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.
flavorText: The Pokémon creates a club out of thorny ivy vines, this club is infused with the power of nature, everchanging.

name: Jaw Lock
addedEffect: Single Target. Bite Move. Blocks both User and Target. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The user will capture its foe in a crushing jaw grip. It won’t let go no matter how much you try to separate them. The only way it will release its victim is if one of them faints.

name: Jet Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
flavorText: The fist of justice strikes true, swift...and wet!

name: Judgment
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. Ignore Defenses. This Move's Type, Power and extra Added Effects are decided by Storyteller. If something would prevent this Move from dealing Damage, ignore it. This Move can't be Clashed.
flavorText: Sooner or later, everyone gets what they deserve.

name: Jump Kick
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
flavorText: The user launches itself up two stories high to pummel down with a powerful kick. Do not try it at home.

name: Jungle Healing
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Heal any Status Ailment (Burn, Freeze, Paralysis, Poison & Sleep) on the Targets. Restore 1 HP to the targets. If successful spend 1 Will point to activate.
flavorText: A stream of life force from plants and trees flow into the User and their Allies.

name: Karate Chop
addedEffect: Single Target. High Critical.
flavorText: A classic karate technique, thi chop that has been practiced and mastered.

name: Kinesis
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
flavorText: A basic display of psychic abilities, making objects and other creatures levitate for a short period of time.

name: King's Shield
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user, Reduce the foe's Strength by 2.
flavorText: Off my chair, jester! The king sits there!

name: Knock Off
addedEffect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
flavorText: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

name: Kowtow Cleave
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
flavorText: The user gets on their knees and bows to its foe, then as the foe accepts this courtesy, a treacherous slash reveals the evil intent of the ruse.

name: Land's Wrath
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique.
flavorText: The earth moves on its own, no attacker in sight. The floor crumbles and the ground shakes engulfing its victims. From the rubble, lush trees emerge a short time after.

name: Laser Focus
addedEffect: Target Self. If the next Physical or Special Move the user performs gets 5 more successes required on the Accuracy Roll, ignore the Target's defenses on the Damage roll.
flavorText: Through its incredible awarenes the Pokémon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is devastating.

name: Lash Out
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if any of the user's Attributes/Traits was lowered this Round.
flavorText: The user fulminates the foe with the power of its frustration and a shriek of despair.

name: Last Resort
addedEffect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
flavorText: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

name: Last Respects
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move for every ally that Fainted during this Battle Up to 8 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The Pokémon gathers the souls the departed and helps them fulfill their desire of revenge before moving on.

name: Lava Plume
addedEffect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
flavorText: The floor is lava. The sky is lava. Everywhere is lava. Hundreds of lava bits start raining scattered around the field.

name: Leaf Blade
addedEffect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
flavorText: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

name: Leaf Storm
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
flavorText: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

name: Leaf Tornado
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.
flavorText: A cluster of leaves and twigs swirls around the foe, getting in its eyes and making it difficult to aim properly

name: Leafage
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged.
flavorText: The user throws leaf darts towards the foe.

name: Leech Life
addedEffect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: The Pokémon clings to their foe, then bites in and starts to suck away its life force.

name: Leech Seed
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

name: Leer
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
flavorText: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

name: Lick
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

name: Life Dew
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

name: Light Of Ruin
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Recoil. Lethal. Unique.
flavorText: By drawing energy from the Eternal Flower, the Pokémon unleashes all of its hurt. A beautiful light surrounds the area, yet the pain inside of its heart remains.

name: Light Screen
addedEffect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

name: Liquidation
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

name: Lock-On
addedEffect: Target Self. The Next Move the User Performs has 2 automatic successes added on their Accuracy Roll.
flavorText: The Pokémon’s eyes zoom into a moving target to strike with precision at the next opportunity.

name: Lovely Kiss
addedEffect: Single Target. Put the Target to Sleep. Pokemon with this Move may forfeit their Beauty score completely, restore 1 Point to their Beauty Score. If the Pokemon forgets this move, restore 1 point to their Beauty Score.
flavorText: A true love’s kiss that could turn any prince into a froakie and put any princess to sleep for a hundred years.

name: Low Kick
addedEffect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

name: Low Sweep
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
flavorText: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

name: Lucky Chant
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.
flavorText: The magical incantation of an old priestess, through dance and song, good fortune and divine protection will come to you. This Move also removes evil spirits and curses.

name: Lumina Crash
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
flavorText: The user flashes a light pattern that crashes the foe’s mind, leaving it acting erraticaly for a few moments.

name: Lunar Blessing
addedEffect: *Target User or Target one Ally. Unique. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Complete Heal. Heal all status Ailments on the Target. Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of one foe.
flavorText: Put your faith on the moon, pray during dark times and it shall bring light into your heart, guide the strayed, and cast away the creatures from the shadows.

name: Lunar Dance
addedEffect: Target Self. Unique. Roll the User's Remaining HP as Typeless Damage dice to itself. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition, if it was fainted, restore conciousness. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
flavorText: The moon shines at the darkest hours, reflecting sun’s life bringer light on those fallen into the night. Cresselia takes pity of their lost souls and guides them towards the dawn.

name: Lunge
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
flavorText: The user charges against the foe at full force, not just to knock it down but to restrain it with its many limbs.

name: Luster Purge
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce Sp. Defense by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times per Target.
flavorText: The user engulfs itself in a blinding light and shoots a light beam at its foe, this light leaves the foe powerless to resist the assault.

name: Mach Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
flavorText: The user launches a punch so quickly that it’s barely seen.

name: Magic Coat
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Support Moves that would target the user or its side of the field are inflicted to the foe performing the Move or that foe's side of the field instead.
flavorText: Through a swift mind trick the Pokémon trick the foe into pouring their ill intent on itself.

name: Magic Powder
addedEffect: Single Target. Powder Move. Change the target's Type to Psychic.
flavorText: The Pokémon recites an enchantment and blows a cloud of pink dust on its Target. Afterwards, the target becomes incredibly good at guessing which card you got from a deck.

name: Magic Room
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Held items lose their effects. No items can be used. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The entire battlefield becomes a room on which the laws of the material world are rendered useless.

name: Magical Leaf
addedEffect: Single Target. Never Miss.
flavorText: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

name: Magical Torque
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance dice to Confuse the Target.
flavorText: With the flick of a wand the user is spun around in a magic swirl that leaves them absolutely dizzy.

name: Magma Storm
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Blocks. Roll 3 Fire-Type Damage Dice ignoring defenses at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots a fiery eruption to its foe. Unable to escape and surrounded by the unbearable heat the foe’s survival is at risk.

name: Magnet Bomb
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. Never Miss. Projectile Move.
flavorText: The user lights the fuse of a magnetized bomb. Guess who is the other magnet?

name: Magnet Rise
addedEffect: Target Self. The User gains Immunity against Ground-Type Moves. Whole Scene Duration
flavorText: The Pokémon creates a magnetic field to repel themselves from the ground, allowing it to float for a short period of time.

name: Magnetic Flux
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in range. Increase by 1 the Defense and Sp. Defense of Electric-Type or Steel-Type Targets.
flavorText: The Pokémon alters the magnetic field around itself to repel damage. This also affects other Pokémon sensible to magnetic charges.

name: Magnitude
addedEffect: Area Move. Ranged. Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
flavorText: The user shakes the tectonic plates underneath the battlefield, trying to find a fault, when they do, this Move is devastating.

name: Make It Rain
addedEffect: Area Move. Reduce the User's Special by 2. At the end of the battle give the User and every Trainer whose Pokemon was hit, Money equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000
flavorText: The Pokémon calls a rain of gold to fall from the sky. All the greedy Pokémon who threw themselves at the money get in range for an explosion of golden light. Worth it!

name: Malignant Chain
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target. At the end of the Round, if the Target was Poisoned by this Move, roll their Loyalty, get at least 3 successes, if it fails, from the next Round the Target becomes the user's Ally untl the poison is healed.
flavorText: This chain contains the most potent neurotoxin currently known. It boosts physical appearance, yet totally suppresses the mind and soul, turning the target into the user’s puppet.

name: Mat Block
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Shield Move. Reaction 1. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses a mat as a shield.

name: Matcha Gotcha
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Projectile Move. Low Accuracy 1. The User restores hp equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. If the user is Frozen solid, destroy the ice block.
flavorText: The user invites the foe to a hebal tea ceremony. As the tea is served and the foe is off guard, the user throws the hot tea on them, then proceeds to enjoy their own cup.

name: Max Airstream
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Dexterity of User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Darkness
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those Affected.

name: Max Flare
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Sunny Weather (Disregard time of day or location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Flutterby
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Special of those Affected.

name: Max Geyser
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Rain Weather. (Disregard location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Guard
addedEffect: Target Max Self. Shield Move. Reaction 5. Reduce 5 Damage this Max Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Move that targets the Max User

name: Max Hailstorm
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Hail Weather. (Disregard location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Knuckle
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase he Strength of Userand Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Lightning
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Electric Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Mindstorm
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Psychic Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Ooze
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Special of User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Overgrowth
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Grassy Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Phantasm
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those Affected.

name: Max Quake
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Sp. Defense of the User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Rockfall
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Sandstorm Weather. (Disregard location Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Starfall
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Misty Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Steelspike
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Defense of the User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Strike
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those Affected.

name: Max Wyrmwind
addedEffect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those Affected.

name: Me First
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
flavorText: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

name: Mean Look
addedEffect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

name: Meditate
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: Through meditation the Pokémon brings forward their mind’s strength into their body.

name: Mega Drain
addedEffect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
flavorText: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

name: Mega Kick
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
flavorText: A mighty kick. This sheer muscle-power strike can turn concrete pillars into rubble.

name: Mega Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon packs everything into this punch to pulverize their foe with a single strike.

name: Megahorn
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

name: Memento
addedEffect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
flavorText: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

name: Metal Burst
addedEffect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
flavorText: Those who live by the sword will die by the sword, or, in this case, by an explosion.

name: Metal Claw
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

name: Metal Sound
addedEffect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
flavorText: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

name: Meteor Assault
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
flavorText: The Pokémon will make an incredible jump to the sky, then lunge towards the foe at a staggering speed, crashing the ground upon impact. The user is left very tired.

name: Meteor Beam
addedEffect: Single Target. Charge Move. Increase the User's Special by 1 the moment it begins charging.
flavorText: The user overflows with galactic energy while summoning a small meteor to impact the foe. A theory suggests this move might have caused the extintion of prehistoric Pokémon.

name: Meteor Mash
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to increase the User's Strength by 1.
flavorText: A great meteor fell, leading to the extinction of all prehistoric Pokémon. The user re-enacts that meteor on a smaller scale, as it only needs to extinguish one.

name: Metronome
addedEffect: Single Target. Copy Move. Roll a die to determine Physical or Special category, roll a die to determine this Move's Power. The appearance, Type and added effects of this Move becomes the same of a Physical or Special Move of the same Power at Storyteller's Discretion.
flavorText: The Pokémon waves their hands following a specific rythm, the energy around follows the cadence and manifests as a Move at random.

name: Mighty Cleave
addedEffect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Shield Moves & Force Fields active on the foe or their side of the field.
flavorText: With a mighty light, the Pokémon cleaves through the foe’s protections and strikes like a boulder.

name: Milk Drink
addedEffect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Out of battle, this Move can be used on allies.
flavorText: The Pokémon drinks a glass of milk. Full of calcium and vitamin D it is a healthy and delicious refreshment.

name: Mimic
addedEffect: Single Target. Copy Move. Replace "Mimic" with the copied Move. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon is a quick learner. They imitate their target’s movements and just like that they get a new set of powers.

name: Mind Blown
addedEffect: Area Move. Recoil.
flavorText: The Pokémon has had a terrible day and has a headache to match. Try not to disturb the peace because their head really feels like exploding.

name: Mind Reader
addedEffect: Single Target. The User has 2 automatic and unremovable successes on the next Accuracy or Evasion Roll against the Target.
flavorText: In a split of second, the Pokémon reads the foe’s mind so they know exactly what to do next.

name: Minimize
addedEffect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round. Reduce the User's Height and Weight in half. The user is now Vulernable to: Stomp. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon compacts their body. Becoming a much smaller target to be difficult to hit. But a well placed stomp may leave them squished on the floor, though.

name: Miracle Eye
addedEffect: Target Self. The User's Psychic-Type Moves ignore Dark-Type Immunity. Target cannot Evade the User's Moves. This Pokemon's Accuracy cannot be Reduced by Move's, Items or Abilities (ie Sand Attack, Bright Powder, etc.). Whole Scene Duration
flavorText: The Pokémon opens up the third eye. Their sight trascends the barriers of flesh. No one goes undetected.

name: Mirror Coat
addedEffect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
flavorText: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

name: Mirror Move
addedEffect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

name: Mirror Shot
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
flavorText: Through a series of reflective surfaces, the Pokémon redirects a beam through unexpected directions. The foe is at a loss; they don’t know if what they see is real or a reflection.

name: Mist
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

name: Mist Ball
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Special by 1. *This Effect can be stacked up to 3 times per target.
flavorText: The user engulfs its foe with a cloud, this soothing mist keeps evil intents from surfacing ino the Target’s mind.

name: Misty Explosion
addedEffect: Area Attack. Lethal. The User faints after using this Move. *If Misty Terrain is active, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
flavorText: The user razes the field with a searing nuke of made of love, joy, kisses, and pink glitter. It is deadly.

name: Misty Terrain
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. All Status Ailments and Conditions are cured and no more can be inflicted. Physical & Special Dragon-Type Moves have Power 0. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The battlefield is shrouded by a pink mist that feels protective and soothing. This mist is able to render even the fiercest beasts into calm.

name: Moonblast
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
flavorText: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

name: Moongeist Beam
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. If anything on the foe's side would prevent this move from dealing damage (Pokemon Type, Abilities, Shield Moves, Weather or Force Fields) ignore it. This Move cannot be clashed.
flavorText: A cold reflection of the moon shines upon the target, it doesn’t hurt physically but those who stare directly into the light simply collapse.

name: Moonlight
addedEffect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Night Time and Sunny Weather increase it to Complete Heal. Rain, Sandstorm and Hail Weather reduceto Minor Heal of 1 HP.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses the moon’s power to heal their injuries.

name: Morning Sun
addedEffect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal only heals 1 HP.
flavorText: The Pokémon feels revitalized with the bright sun early in the mornings.

name: Mortal Spin
addedEffect: All Foes in Range. Poison those Affected. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User or their side of the field.
flavorText: The user spins around the field, cutting through obstacles and shooting small darts full of a toxic venom. The earth is now poisoned and left barren.

name: Mountain Gale
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.

name: Mud Bomb
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots a ball of mud to burst on their victim’s face in an attempt to blind them.

name: Mud Shot
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

name: Mud Slap
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
flavorText: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

name: Mud Sport
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

name: Muddy Water
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.
flavorText: When you can’t see what creatures lurk inside the water, that’s when you know they are the ones that went fishing.

name: Multi-Attack
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. This Move's type will change to match the User's Main Type.
flavorText: A weird-looking Pokémon charged against its foes, the same attack released different kinds of energy depending on the disk the Pokémon is holding.

name: Mystical Fire
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Special by 1.
flavorText: An iridicent fire that not just burns in the physical world but in the spiritual world as well.

name: Mystical Power
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's lowest Attribute/Trait. If an Attribute/Trait Score is 6 or More, this effect fails. Different Attributes/Traits may be increased this way.
flavorText: The power is inside you. You can feel it in your heart, you can see it in your mind. Believe in yourself and take it!

name: Nasty Plot
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
flavorText: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

name: Natural Gift
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. The User loes its held berry. *The Type of this Move changes according to the berry used. See more on p. 530
flavorText: The user throws their held berry at the foe, the myriad of flavors has surprisingly different results.

name: Nature Power
addedEffect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
flavorText: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

name: Nature's Madness
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Damage Roll is Half of the Target's remaining HP (up to 10 Dice) Rounded down. If the remaining HP of the Target is 1, this move fails. Ignore Defenses.
flavorText: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere, even your own body will fail you.

name: Needle Arm
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon flails their arms with violence against the foe, the arms have grown thorns that sting like needles.

name: Never-Ending Nightmare
addedEffect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Ignore Ability, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Night Daze
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy rolls of the foe. Outside of battle, obscuring effects last for a whole scene.
flavorText: The foe is engulfed by a pitch-black darkness that obscure its vision and torments its mind.

name: Night Shade
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advanced 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
flavorText: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

name: Night Slash
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
flavorText: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

name: Nightmare
addedEffect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition. Deal 1 Typeless Damage to the Target after every attempt to resist its Sleep Condition where it doesn't wake up.
flavorText: The user is believed to transport themselves to the land of dreams to torment their victims with vivid night terrors. The vicitms wake up with unexplainable injuries.

name: No Retreat
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: No surrender. No retreat. Until victory, always!

name: Noble Roar
addedEffect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
flavorText: The mighty roar of a king. It commands respect and authority over anyone who listens.

name: Noxious Torque
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
flavorText: Surrounded by noxious gases, the victim is spun around at high speeds.

name: Nuzzle
addedEffect: Single Target. Paralyze the foe.
flavorText: The Pokémon gives a cute nuzzle at their target, it looks adorable until you see the sparks.

name: Oblivion Wing
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Unique.
flavorText: A dark wind rises, turning everything it touches into dust to be scattered until nothing remains. People, Pokémon, plants, everything fades like a distant memory.

name: Obstruct
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user Reduce the foe's Defense by 2.
flavorText: In a reckless action, the user charges against the foe to stop its momentum and block its incoming attack. Being so close allows the user to reach for weak spots.

name: Octazooka
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.
flavorText: A jet of black ink shot straight into the foe’s eyes. This Move is hard to aim but returns the favor.

name: Octolock
addedEffect: Single Target. Block. Reduce by 1 the Target's Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The user wraps its tentacles to immobilize the foe. Being so close enables the user to find weak spots.

name: Odor Sleuth
addedEffect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

name: Ominous Wind
addedEffect: Single Target. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The battlefield gets absolutely silent, the only noise is a cold wind draft that gives the target chills and goosebumps. Observing from the shadows, the user rejoices in the fear.

name: Order Up
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. If the User is giving cover to a #978 Tatsugiri Ally. Increase by 1 an Attribute depending on the Ally's color. *Orange - Strength *Red - Defense *Yellow - Dexterity
flavorText: The user waits for orders and adheres to the strategy of a smaller but smarter ally.

name: Origin Pulse
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Water-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using a Move, this Move hits anyways.
flavorText: The Pokémon sends a giant pulse underwater that creates a chain reaction in the tides, creating a series of tsunami waves. Not even water-pokemon can surf through these wild currents.

name: Outrage
addedEffect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
flavorText: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

name: Overdrive
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses its own body as an amplifier for the energizing sounds it produces.

name: Overheat
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
flavorText: A furious scorching flame that turns everything on the user’s radius to ash. This incredible destructive display leaves the user exhausted.

name: Pain Split
addedEffect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
flavorText: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

name: Parabolic Charge
addedEffect: Area Move. The User restore HP equal to half the damage to one Target, rounded down.
flavorText: The Pokémon lets loose a big electric charge from its body. The charge comes back to it even bigger.

name: Parting Shot
addedEffect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User. Reduce by 1 the Foe's Strength and Special.
flavorText: The user throws one last threat against the foe before taking their leave. The foe is left too frightened to try to stand up against the user and their gang.

name: Pay Day
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. At the end of the battle give Money to your Trainer Equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000
flavorText: This Pokémon brings good fortune to businesses and trainers alike. Make sure to use some of that hard earned money to buy them a treat.

name: Payback
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
flavorText: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

name: Peck
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

name: Perish Song
addedEffect: Area Move. Sound Move. Three Rounds after this Move is used, deal damage to those affected equal to their remaining HP. Removing from battle prevents this effect.
flavorText: A song for mourning the departed. Although it sounds beautiful, it fills the heart with grief and despair, making the listeners feel as if they were laying on their death bed.

name: Petal Blizzard
addedEffect: Area Move. Ranged. Wind Move.
flavorText: A raging blizzard of petals and leaves sweeps through the entire area, leaving a pleasant floral scent and destruction in its wake.

name: Petal Dance
addedEffect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
flavorText: The Pokémon casts a huge cluster of petals to dance in the wind; they let nature run its course, as the wind will choose who will take the devastating blow.

name: Phantom Force
addedEffect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Ignore any Cover, Shield Moves, and/or Force Fields active on the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable fortress. It may reappear during its next action.

name: Photon Geyser
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move's Damage Pool, can be rolled with either Strength or Special Attribute, dealing Physical or Special Damage respectively. Choose whatever is most convenient for the user.
flavorText: The Pokémon attacks with a large pillar of light that comes out from they stand, either the blazing energy or the crushing strike are enough to knock foes out.

name: Pika Papow
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point of Happiness on the User. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
flavorText: The User lets out its energy in the form of a lightning strike, the happier the user feels the more energized it will be.

name: Pin Missile
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions.
flavorText: The Pokémon shoots a barrage of stingers or spikes that pierce like needles.

name: Plasma Fists
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. If successful, all Normal-Type Moves of the User will be considered Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The user charges its fists with electricity, upon impact, the charge materializes into plasma that adds an electric element to all of its Normal moves.

name: Play Nice
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

name: Play Rough
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

name: Pluck
addedEffect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding a Berry, Add 1 Die to the Damage pool of this Move. The User also eats the berry and gains its effects.
flavorText: The Pokémon lands on top of the foe and starts pecking them in search for parasites or some other tasty treat to snack on.

name: Poison Fang
addedEffect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon goes for a quick bite, releasing the foe just as fast. Let the poison slowly consume the foe from the inside out. No need to spend more energy when a drop is more than enough.

name: Poison Gas
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Poison those affected.
flavorText: A thick cloud of toxic gas that causes violent coughs and red eyes.

name: Poison Jab
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

name: Poison Powder
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Poison the Target.
flavorText: A cloud of noxius powder that immediately sends the target’s immune system into overdrive.

name: Poison Sting
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
flavorText: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

name: Poison Tail
addedEffect: Single Target. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
flavorText: A sharp edge dipped in venom—an attack in bad blood in all senses of the word.

name: Pollen Puff
addedEffect: Single Target. Projectile Move. * Or target One Ally. *When this move is used against an ally, it will heal 2 HP instead of damage, Spend 1 Will Point to get this effect.
flavorText: The Pokémon creates a puff of pollen that explodes on the foe's face and gives them a terrible allergy. When consumed, these puffs are sweet and very nutritious.

name: Poltergeist
addedEffect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target is Holding an Item or if Items have been used on the Target's side of the field.
flavorText: The Pokémon’s spirit possesses an Item and attacks with that cursed object. It is said that if the Pokémon lingers too long possesing an object, it’ll have trouble getting out.

name: Population Bomb
addedEffect: Single Target. Unique. Low Accuracy 2. Successive Actions.
flavorText: The Pokémon and their family attack the foe in waves. Parents, children, cousins, aunts, uncles, and extended relatives, the whole family tree will appear on an onslaught.

name: Pounce
addedEffect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon stands very still, and just as their foe approaches, they suddenly launch into attacking.

name: Pound
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

name: Powder
addedEffect: Single Target. Powder Move. The next time the Target uses a Fire-Type Move, Roll Typeless Damage Dice equal to that Move's power, ignore defenses.
flavorText: The foe gets covered by a very flammable powder, the smallest source of fire will ignite it with explosive results.

name: Powder Snow
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
flavorText: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

name: Power Gem
addedEffect: Single Target.
flavorText: With a crystal gem, the Pokémon will always save the day!

name: Power Shift
addedEffect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with its Defense and its Special with its Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The Pokémon knows that sometimes the best defense is a good offense.

name: Power Split
addedEffect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
flavorText: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

name: Power Swap
addedEffect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Strength and Special with the Target's.
flavorText: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its power and implant on them the idea of their own frailty.

name: Power Trick
addedEffect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with their Defense and Special with their Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The Pokémon tricks their own mind to believe their vitality is their power and vice versa.

name: Power Trip
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of this move for every Attribute increase the user has. (ie The user has 2 increased points on Defense, add 2 Damage dice).
flavorText: In the heat of the battle, the Pokémon gets carried away, reveling on their own power.

name: Power Whip
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
flavorText: A thick vine full of thorns is waved as a whip against the enemy. As devastating as the blow would be, the incoming attack is easily percieved by the foe.

name: Power-Up Punch
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. Increase User's Strength by 1.
flavorText: A punch to test the impact’s surface and adjust the level of strength required to punch through it.

name: Precipice Blades
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's Immunity to Ground-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using any Move, this Move hits anyways.
flavorText: Giant blades emerge from the earth impaling the unlucky souls nearby. Do you think you are safe in the air? Think again...

name: Present
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. *Target rolls 1 die with a 50-50 chance of dealing 2 Set Damage to the Target or Restoring 2 HP to the Target.
flavorText: The user hands out a lovely present box. Time to find out if the foe has been naugthy or nice

name: Prismatic Laser
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Must Recharge. Unique.
flavorText: Through a prism, the user shoots a concentrated laser beam that pierces everything that comes in contact with it. The effort leaves the user mentally exhausted.

name: Protect
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
flavorText: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

name: Psybeam
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
flavorText: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

name: Psyblade
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. *If Electric Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon attacks using an ethereal blade. Electric energy will increase the sharpness of its edge.

name: Psych Up
addedEffect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
flavorText: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

name: Psychic
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
flavorText: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

name: Psychic Fangs
addedEffect: Single Target. Bite Move. If there is a Force Field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it.
flavorText: The Pokémon bares its fangs to bite the foe, psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.

name: Psychic Noise
addedEffect: Single Target. Target can't restore HP. Duration 2 Rounds.
flavorText: The target gets a migraine so awful it can only hear white noise inside of its head.

name: Psychic Terrain
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Psychic-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground can't use Moves with Reaction or Late Reaction. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The arena becomes radiated by psychic waves. Everyone feels their mind slog due to the buzz in their heads, making all tasks take longer than they should.

name: Psycho Boost
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Unique. Reduce User's Special by 2.
flavorText: The Pokémon releases an explosion of all of its concentrated psychic power in a devastating explosion, afterwards the user will be extremely tired.

name: Psycho Cut
addedEffect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
flavorText: The user sends out an invisible sword made with psychic energy that slashes targets even if they are far away

name: Psycho Shift
addedEffect: Single Target. Copy all of the User's Status Ailments into the Target. Afterwards, Heal the User from any Status Ailment.
flavorText: Through sheer mental suggestion, the user actually makes their target feel their sickness. The user convinces themselves they are healed afterwards.

name: Psyshield Bash
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The user cloaks itself in a shield of psychic energy then rams into the foe.

name: Psyshock
addedEffect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
flavorText: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

name: Psystrike
addedEffect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move is resisted with the Foe's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
flavorText: Through sheer psychic power, the user materializes its energy to deal a heavy strike to its foe.

name: Psywave
addedEffect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advanced 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
flavorText: A powerful mental wave assault’s the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

name: Punishment
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of the Move for every Attribute increase the target has. (ie The target has 2 increased points on Strength, add 2 Damage dice).
flavorText: You shouldn’t have done that...

name: Purify
addedEffect: Single Target. Heal a Target's Status Ailment (Burns, Freeze, Paralysis, Poisons, Sleep). *If a Status Ailment was healed this way, the User may spend 1 Will point to restore 2 HP.
flavorText: The target is covered by a gelatinous goo to which every impurity sticks. The user then convinces the target eats this goo, and ends up pleasantly surprised by the sweet flavor.

name: Pursuit
addedEffect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
flavorText: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

name: Pyro Ball
addedEffect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Ranged. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
flavorText: The Pokémon lights a heavy stone on fire and kicks it while it’s ablaze. The hit is pretty heavy already, the fire is just for showing off.

name: Quash
addedEffect: Single Target. Target's will go last in the Initiative Order. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. If used again, the previous Target has their order in the initiative restored.
flavorText: The user represses the foe through intimidation so it thinks twice before acting.

name: Quick Attack
addedEffect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
flavorText: An attackas fight as lightning.

name: Quick Guard
addedEffect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
flavorText: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullyfing the effects of the fastest attacks.

name: Quiver Dance
addedEffect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Dexterity, Special an Sp. Defense.
flavorText: A mystical and beautiful dance that increases a Pokémon focus in combat.

name: Rage
addedEffect: Single Target. If a foe damages the User with a Physical or Special Move in the same round after using this Move. Increase the User's Strength by 1. This effect can stack up to 3 Times.
flavorText: The user gets angry and throws a tantrum against the foe. The more the battle continues the angrier the user gets.

name: Rage Fist
addedEffect: Single Target. Fist Move. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move for every time the User has received Damage this Round, up to 8 Dice may be added this way.
flavorText: The Pokémon focuses all of their rage into a single fist, the more they suffered the more dark energy will concentrate.

name: Rage Powder
addedEffect: Target Self. Reaction 2. Powder Move. All of the Foe's Physical and Special Moves will Target the user if able. Duration 1 Round.
flavorText: The Pokémon releases an irritating powder that itches and enrages its foes into full-attack mode.

name: Raging Bull
addedEffect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible, otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances and STAB accordingly.
flavorText: The Pokémon charges against a foe, trampling through with a righteous fury, a blazing rage, a cold wrath, or maybe just the senseless desire for violence.

name: Raging Fury
addedEffect: Target Random foe. Ranged. Rampage.
flavorText: The Pokémon goes mad with rage, spitting fire viciously all over the battlfield and barely recognizing friend from foe.

name: Rain Dance
addedEffect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

name: Rapid Spin
addedEffect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
flavorText: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

name: Razor Leaf
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
flavorText: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

name: Razor Shell
addedEffect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
flavorText: The Pokémon sharpens a seashell to use as a cutting tool, when this shell manages to cut through the foe’s armor, they’ll finally will have mastered the craft.

name: Razor Wind
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Charge Move. High Critical. Cutter Move.
flavorText: The Pokémon sways the winds while charging what appears to be an invisible blade made of pressurized air. The wind slices everything it touches as if it were a razor.

name: Recover
addedEffect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
flavorText: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

name: Recycle
addedEffect: Target Self. The Pokemon reuses an Item (Berries, Potions, Full Heal, etc.) that has already been spent during the battle on any side of the battlefield. Recycle can't be used more than 3 times per battle by the User.
flavorText: One Pokémon’s trash is another one’s treasure.

name: Reflect
addedEffect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
flavorText: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

name: Reflect Type
addedEffect: Target Self. Change the User's Type to match the one(s) of a foe. (ie Staryu is battle vs Charizard, their type will become Fire/Flying intead of Water) Whole Scene Duration.
flavorText: The Pokémon is able to rewrite their own cellular composition at will to match that of potential predators. Increasing chances of survival.

name: Refresh
addedEffect: Target Self. The User heals itself from any Burn, Freeze, Poison and Paralysis. Sleep is not healed through this effect.
flavorText: The Pokémon takes a few seconds to cool off, refocus, and get back in the game.

name: Relic Song
addedEffect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Unique. Roll 1 Chance Die to put the foe to Sleep. If successful, the User may choose to change its form afterwards.
flavorText: The user sings and dances to a melody so beautiful you won’t notice you were crying while listening to it.

name: Rest
addedEffect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
flavorText: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

name: Retaliate
addedEffect: Single Target. *If an Ally fainted during this or the previous Round, add Extra Dice to the damage pool, equal to the user's Loyalty. Up to 5 dice may be added this way. This effect only activates once per fainted Ally.
flavorText: With tears of rage in their eyes, the Pokémon will not let the fall of a friend go without punishment.

name: Return
addedEffect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point of Happiness on the User, up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
